Rr.bar_b_note: All three frames (Kelm, Captain Veyra, Veyra defeated) show only the trainer's back on flat green lawn before a flat wall with pasted gold doors; no speaker, no atmosphere, so the bright Cloudreach sky alone cannot carry it.

Lh.bar_b_note: B's larger blue-grey translucent panel with pale border and warm ingredient text is on-direction and readable at both resolutions, but A's clipped tiny rows and the plain tall list cells keep it short of Palworld's dense, iconic HUD finish.

Xd.bar_b_note: Nalia's frame shows only the trainer on a pale sand slope and both Nerissa frames stare into a dark rock wall with no person at all, which sinks it.

Wi.bar_b_note: Mira, Tam and Oskar now match their portraits and face camera in front of a warm village, which carries it, but flat midday light, a toy-like finish and an identical stand in every frame stop it short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

Ox.bar_b_note: The Tidewake look itself is right (cyan/navy water, pale dunes, bright sky), but Daro, Bex and Irva are tiny figures beside the trainer in a wide shot, so the subject never reads.

Qb.bar_b_note: Both Captain Marrow frames are filled by a flat blue slab with a gold lightning bolt, and the Nysa frame, though well lit with moss and storm violet, has a cropped head intruding at the left edge.

Lf.bar_b_note: Oswin and Elder Maud read well over the trainer's shoulder under purple storm sky and rain, but Fenn's frame is a black void with only the trainer visible, which sinks it.

Gm.bar_b_note: B's storm wolf holds the style bar's fur and violet streaks through a real rear-up hit react and grounded faint, but A's faint frames swap to a broken white-and-black blob and the flat neutral stage offers no Valheim-class light.

Fj.bar_b_note: The grey-haired elder has an expressive face, clear eyes, a warm moss-and-leather palette and a clean full-body silhouette at a shipping-character finish, though big-eyed styling sits softer than the naturalistic creatures.

Uv.bar_b_note: A dark muddy grade, a HUD covering about a third of each frame, flat magenta ring and square telegraphs, and (side A i11, i13, i15) trunks and canopy filling the camera sink it against Palworld's bright, readable boss fights.

top_changes.change: Dialogue camera: always cut to a medium shot that frames the named speaker beside the panel, cull or fade foreground occluders (shields, trunks, other actors) and keep the camera out of rock walls and darkness; this lifts Rr, Xd, Ox, Qb and Lf.
Make sure every named speaker is actually placed and lit at the dialogue spot (Kelm, Veyra, Nalia, Nerissa, Fenn, Marrow), rather than leaving only the portrait.
Swap the flat magenta ring and square telegraphs for real effects (cracking ground, thrown stones, white-violet lightning) with impacts, and cut the fight HUD down so both fighters read in Stormwood.
